title: ScreenGui
summary: The 2D canvas for screen-space UI: parent Frames, labels, and buttons into one. Controls reset-on-spawn behavior (ResetOnSpawn), layering (DisplayOrder), and inset handling.

properties.name: ResetOnSpawn
properties.description: Whether this GUI is destroyed & re-copied at each respawn (default true). Set false for persistent HUDs.

properties.name: DisplayOrder
properties.description: Stacking layer between ScreenGuis — higher draws on top.

properties.name: IgnoreGuiInset
properties.description: Draw under the Roblox topbar/notch area (fullscreen UIs).

properties.name: ScreenInsets
properties.description: Which safe insets the gui respects (device notches, topbar).

explanation.whatItIs: The invisible sheet of glass your UI lives on. It renders nothing itself — it hosts everything else.
explanation.whyItExists: UI needs a coordinate space, a layering group, and respawn policy. ScreenGui is that container.
whenToUse: One ScreenGui per logical UI: HUD, Shop, Menu, Chat
DisplayOrder to stack menus above HUD
ResetOnSpawn=false for anything that should survive death
whenNotToUse: For UI attached to 3D objects — BillboardGui/SurfaceGui instead
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
PlayerGui
 ├─ HUD (ScreenGui, DisplayOrder=1, ResetOnSpawn=false)
 ├─ Shop (ScreenGui, DisplayOrder=10)
 └─ Menu (ScreenGui, DisplayOrder=20)
Higher DisplayOrder = drawn on top.
```
tips: Name GUIs meaningfully and find them by WaitForChild, not position assumptions
Group per-feature; toggle whole features with Enabled
commonMistakes: HUD disappearing every death → ResetOnSpawn was true
Menu appearing UNDER the HUD → DisplayOrder unset (all 0, undefined order)
Putting GUIs directly in PlayerGui without a ScreenGui — GuiObjects need a ScreenGui (or Billboard/SurfaceGui) ancestor to render

examples.title: Persistent HUD scaffold
examples.code:
-- LocalScript
local playerGui = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local hud = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
hud.Name = "HUD"
hud.ResetOnSpawn = false       -- survives deaths
hud.DisplayOrder = 1
hud.Parent = playerGui

local menu = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
menu.Name = "ShopMenu"
menu.Enabled = false            -- hidden until opened
menu.DisplayOrder = 10          -- above HUD when visible
menu.Parent = playerGui
